create.name: Hope Fitzgerald
create.bio:
Hope Fitzgerald traces her spiritual path to a moment of awakening at the Findhorn community in Scotland in 1976. In the decades since she has worked as a counsellor, an intuitive dowser using L-rods to put questions to a wider intelligence, a channel, and a companion to people near the end of life. In 2010 a sequence of visions gave her the Infinity Wave, a flowing figure-of-eight that she teaches as a simple practice for meeting any situation with love and compassion. Her book, The Infinity Wave: Mastering the Art of Love, Compassion, and Flow, tells that story and sets out the basic exercises.

Most of her work happens online through her Wave Energy Center. She gives one-to-one dowsing and coaching sessions, teaches beginners to dowse in a short course, and hosts a monthly rhythm of gatherings: a free meditation evening, a channelling salon, an astrology-led circle and a community call. She also runs the Infinite Wisdom interview series with other teachers, offers self-paced recordings on the elements, and has taken small groups to sacred landscapes in Peru, Easter Island and the British Isles. With the composer Gary Malkin she leads You, Awake, a programme that pairs music with contemplative practice, and she brings that partnership to Kripalu.

books.title: The Infinity Wave: Mastering the Art of Love, Compassion, and Flow
books.author: Hope Fitzgerald
books.description: Part memoir and part manual. She recounts the visions that first showed her the Infinity Wave and then explains how to use the figure-of-eight in everyday life, with the core practices that came through in its early years.

courses.title: Love Your Life! Awakening to the Beauty of Being Alive
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu co-led with the composer Gary Malkin. Music, contemplative exercises, channelled sessions and group sharing are used to look at change and mortality and to come back to gratitude for being alive.

courses.title: Private Intuitive Dowsing Sessions and Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in which she works through your questions with dowsing rods and whatever guidance arises. Single sessions of 30 or 60 minutes are offered, along with a month-long series of four half-hour sessions ($350 USD).

courses.title: Intro to Dowsing with Hope Fitzgerald
courses.description: A beginners' course on dowsing as a way of listening for inner guidance. It covers grounding before you start, finding your own yes and no, and framing clear questions for everyday decisions.

courses.title: Foundations: Wisdom of the Elements
courses.description: A self-paced set of seven channelled audio recordings, one each for earth, water, fire, air, climate, biodiversity and the web of life. Each is meant as a meditation on your place within the natural world, with lifetime access.

courses.title: Channeling Salon
courses.description: A monthly evening on Zoom, held on the third Monday, where she steps aside to let a range of guides speak to the group. Each salon is booked separately.

free_resources.title: Meditation Library and Monday Meditations
free_resources.description: Recorded channelled meditations and chants to stream from her site, plus a free monthly Monday-evening meditation on Zoom that anyone can join.

free_resources.title: Echoes of Awakening: Begin Your Path to Inner Harmony
free_resources.description: A free four-week online introduction made with Gary Malkin. It moves through deep listening to music, the Infinity Wave, inner exploration and opening the heart, with recorded tracks and short exercises.

free_resources.title: Infinity Circle
free_resources.description: A monthly online circle on the first Monday that gathers current astrological readings from several sources, opens up questions and closes with a channelled meditation. Entry is pay what you can, from nothing.

flags: Kripalu's bio says she is on The Shift Network faculty, and she is in the-shift-network-faculty.json, but only as an 'older' speaker with no current or upcoming course (her Shift profile page returned 'Access denied' to curl), so the-shift-network is not added to teaches_at.

The Kripalu weekend is co-led with Gary Malkin and its page frames it partly around grief and loss ('Turn Heartache into Gratitude', 'healing music'); kept because the title is clean and it is a contemplative workshop, not therapy, but a human may prefer to drop it.
Availability set to worldwide: sessions, classes and gatherings are online (Zoom); her Facebook page gives Greenfield (likely Massachusetts) but no in-person base or classes were found.
Hub bio also calls her a healer, neurofeedback practitioner and end-of-life midwife; the bio mentions only end-of-life companionship, and nothing clinical is listed.
Her site has a Wellness page selling supplements and structured-water products; nothing from it is listed.
Most YouTube uploads are Infinite Wisdom interviews where guests do most of the talking; only her own teaching and 7 Days of Rest meditations were chosen.
left_out: The Infinity Wave Practice for Stress, Anxiety, and Emotional Balance (YouTube): 'anxiety' in the title.
Infinite Wisdom interviews (e.g. Pam Gregory, Heather Ensworth, Kryssa Bowman on trauma, Emmanuel Dagher 'Heal Your Body'): guest is the main speaker, and some titles carry health claims.
